speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am here to help you today. To begin, how long have you been experiencing diarrhea, and has there been any fever or blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (likely Clostridioides difficile infection). Given the patient's recent treatment with levofloxacin for community-acquired pneumonia, the high frequency of watery stools, and associated cramping, C. diff is the primary concern. I will order a stool test to confirm. REQUEST TEST: Stool_C.diff_toxin PCR
